Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.
We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer with expertise in both machine learning (ML) and Generative AI (GenAI) to join our Emerging Technology Practice. In this role, you will drive the development of cutting-edge AI models and solutions-from statistical modeling and predictive analytics to advanced generative and agentic applications.
Design and develop AI-powered systems using both traditional ML and Generative AI techniques, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
Build intelligent applications and agentic systems that can perform tasks autonomously or interactively, using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar
Architect and implement end-to-end RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding generation, vector indexing, hybrid search, and contextual response generation
Develop modular, well-documented APIs and service components (e.g., using FastAPI or Flask) to enable model integration and consumption
Design, build, and manage end-to-end AI pipelines, including data ingestion, transformation, validation, model training, inference, deployment, and knowledge retrieval workflows
Leverage AWS and Azure AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Document Intelligence, vector databases, etc.) to accelerate development and deployment
Implement observability, evaluation, and monitoring mechanisms to track model accuracy, drift, retrieval quality, grounding fidelity, reliability, and task-level reasoning
Optimize RAG systems for latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and response quality in production environments
Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, solution architects, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless solution design and transition to production
Support both rapid experimentation (POCs, pilots) and robust, scalable deployments, depending on the maturity of each use case
Stay up to date with emerging trends in Generative AI, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, RAG evaluation techniques, and continuous improvement methodologies
4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development or intelligent application engineering
Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern ML/AI libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenAI APIs)
Hands-on experience designing and deploying RAG-based systems, including embeddings, vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search), and retrieval optimization techniques
Experience building APIs or backend services using FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent frameworks
Exposure to agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen) and multi-agent orchestration patterns
Experience with orchestration standards or tools such as MCP or agent routing protocols is a plus
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerization tools (Docker)
Hands-on experience with cloud-based ML platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker, or Google AI/ML services
Experience with MLOps pipelines, CI/CD for model delivery, RAG evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS), or model monitoring is a plus
Knowledge of AI system evaluation, observability, prompt performance testing, and grounding validation is a plus
Ability to work on cross-functional teams, balance multiple projects, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences
Cloud certifications in AI/ML services (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud) are a plus
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
Position Level Associate
Country India

Core: Expert Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and Hugging Face
Infrastructure: Proficiency in AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, or Vertex AI
Data: Expertise in vector embeddings, prompt engineering, and semantic search.

We are looking for a highly skilled Generative AI Engineer to join our team at Luxoft India LLP. The ideal candidate will have experience in developing and implementing artificial intelligence and machine learning models, with a strong background in these areas.

Roles and Responsibility

Design and develop generative AI models to solve complex problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into existing systems.
Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines for model training and deployment.
Conduct research and stay updated on the latest advancements in AI and machine learning.
Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and develop solutions.
Deploy and monitor AI models in production environments.
Job Requirements

Strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, and statistics.
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Position Overview

As an AI Engineer at Prescient, you will build and deploy GenAI / agentic AI systems that power our competitive intelligence products in the pharmaceutical and life sciences space. Your role involves developing LLM agents that query external data sources, creating retrieval pipelines over specialized content, implementing evaluation frameworks, and building APIs and dashboards that deliver insights to analysts and clients. You will work in a fast-paced environment with tight feedback loops, real users, and short release cycles, directly contributing to Prescient's technology-driven competitive advantage in the life sciences consulting sector.




Example Responsibilities

Design and implement agentic AI systems that query external data sources and process pharmaceutical and biotech information
Develop robust retrieval pipelines over specialized life sciences content to extract valuable competitive intelligence
Create and maintain evaluation harnesses to ensure accuracy, reliability, and ethical operation of AI systems
Engineer production-grade prompts and structured-output parsing mechanisms for consistent AI performance
Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) stacks to enhance knowledge retrieval from domain-specific content
Develop REST APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks to integrate AI capabilities into Prescient's product ecosystem
Design and implement dashboards that effectively communicate AI-generated insights to analysts and clients
Collaborate with data scientists and domain experts to continuously improve AI system performance and relevance
Write clean, typed, and well-tested Python code following best practices for maintainability and scalability
Troubleshoot complex issues in multi-turn agent interactions and implement robust error handling mechanisms



Education, Experience, Knowledge & Other Skills

Required

34 years experience writing production Python, including async, typed and tested code
Experience shipping an agentic system involving tool calling, multi-turn state and failure handling
Experience building or maintaining an evaluation set for LLM output
Production prompt engineering and structured-output parsing expertise
Experience building one RAG stack end to end
REST API development using FastAPI or similar frameworks
Relational database fundamentals and ability to write non-trivial SQL queries
B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent education

Preferred

Agent harness engineering, including execution environments, sandboxing, permissions, context management, retries, interrupts and sub-agent spawning
Agent control-loop design, including self-verification, stopping criteria, turn limits and recoverable error handling
Experience with LangGraph, Strands, MCP or AWS Bedrock AgentCore
Familiarity with Braintrust, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval or equivalent evaluation tooling
Life sciences or pharma data exposure
Front-end development for internal tools using HTML, JavaScript, charting libraries or React
Experience with Docker, ECS or Kubernetes



What We Offer

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI systems with direct impact on pharmaceutical and life sciences decision-making
Collaborative environment with a team of technology and domain experts
Clear career progression path with mentorship from senior technical leaders
Professional development opportunities including training, and certifications
Competitive compensation package with comprehensive benefits
Flexible hybrid working arrangement at our Gurugram office

Notice Period: Immediate Joiner

Experience: 4-8 years

Location: Gurgaon, 5 Days WFO
